label: Randomness, loot and rewards
summary: Add loot allocation and reward claims to the separately selected verifiable-randomness capability with explicit odds, replay and solvency guarantees.
requiredFacts: Loot table, probabilities, supply, scarcity, duplicate policy and public odds disclosure
Reward funding, reservation, claim authorization, replay boundary and unclaimed-value treatment
Jurisdiction, age, purchase and promotional constraints requiring owner legal review
requiredFiles: Loot and reward adversarial test evidence
requiredTests: Loot supply, probability, reservation and reward-solvency conservation
Duplicate outcome, replay, unclaimed reward and exhausted-supply scenarios
Public odds commitment and allocation parity across deterministic fixtures
risks: Unreserved rewards or duplicate fulfillment can make claims insolvent
Loot mechanics can create legal or platform-policy obligations beyond contract correctness
